;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2015–2018 Iraqi protests]]
**Seven people are killed and more than 30 are injured during a rally in [[Basra]], [[Iraq]] after security forces opened fire. [https://m.yenisafak.com/en/world/seven-dead-more-than-30-wounded-in-southern-iraqs-rally-3440284 (''Yeni Şafak English'')]
*[[Libyan civil war]]
**The [[United Nations]] reports that a ceasefire has been agreed upon by non-governmental militias fighting in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45414753 (BBC)]

;Arts and culture
*The new book of investigative journalist [[Bob Woodward]], ''[[Fear (Woodward book)|Fear]]'', draws the ire of the [[White House]]. [http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2018/09/04/white-house-fires-back-at-woodward-book-detailing-infighting-insults-administrative-coup-detat.html (Fox News)] [https://www.vox.com/2018/9/4/17819298/woodward-book-fear-trump-north-korea-mattis-syria-assad (Vox)]
*A pair of [[Judy Garland]]'s famous [[ruby slippers]] from ''[[The Wizard of Oz (1939 film)|The Wizard of Oz]]'' (1939) are recovered by police. The shoes were stolen from a museum in [[Grand Rapids, Minnesota]] in 2005. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-45411765 (BBC)]

;Business and economy
*[[International reactions to the Saudi-led intervention in Yemen (2015–present)|International reactions to the Saudi-led intervention in Yemen]]
**[[Spain]] confirms that it has cancelled the sale of 400 [[laser-guided bomb]]s to [[Saudi Arabia]] because of concerns about the weapons' use in the [[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present) |conflict in Yemen]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-saudi-spain/spain-confirms-it-has-halted-sale-of-bombs-to-saudi-arabia-idUSKCN1LK1N2 (Reuters)] 
*[[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] becomes the second trillion-dollar company in the United States. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-45414331 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Jebi (2018)|Typhoon Jebi]] kills at least 11 people in [[Japan]], while more than 300 are injured. It is considered the strongest typhoon in the country in 25 years. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45417035 (BBC)]
*A bridge collapses in [[Kolkata]], resulting in three deaths and 25 injuries. [https://www.oneindia.com/amphtml/india/kolkata-bridge-collapse-one-more-body-found-death-toll-reaches-3-2770354.html (Oneindia)]

;Law and crime
*70 protesters, including television actress [[Piper Perabo]], are arrested at the [[Brett Kavanaugh Supreme Court nomination]]. [https://people.com/politics/piper-perabo-arrested-at-brett-kavanaugh-hearing/ (''People'')] [http://thehill.com/regulation/administration/405049-capitol-police-arrest-70-people-during-first-day-of-kavanaugh (''The Hill'')]
*[[Table Rock Lake duck boat accident]]
**Tia Coleman, an [[Indianapolis]] woman who lost her husband and eight other relatives in the sinking of a duck boat in [[Branson, Missouri]], files a lawsuit against the tour boat operators and manufacturer. [https://www.indystar.com/story/news/crime/2018/09/04/duck-boat-accident-survivor-tia-coleman-sues-missouri-company-ripley-entertainment/1190380002/ (''Indy Star'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Brett Kavanaugh Supreme Court nomination]]
**The [[U.S. Senate Judiciary Committee]] opens confirmation hearings for [[U.S. Supreme Court]] nominee [[Brett Kavanaugh]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/09/04/643707613/kavanaugh-supreme-court-confirmation-hearings-begin (NPR)]
*The [[European Ombudsman]], [[Emily O'Reilly]], mentions four counts of maladministration by the [[European Commission]] in the fast-track nomination of [[Martin Selmayr]] as its [[Secretary-General of the European Commission|Secretary-General]] in February. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45407247 (BBC)]
*[[Chicago mayoral election, 2019]]
**[[Mayor of Chicago|Chicago Mayor]] [[Rahm Emanuel]] announces he will not seek a third term in 2019. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/rahm-emanuel-chicago-mayor-will-not-seek-3rd-term-today-2018-09-04/ (CBS News)]
*[[Jimmy Morales|Government of Jimmy Morales]]
**President Jimmy Morales and the National Security Council of Guatemala banned the re-entry into the national territory of the head of the  CICIG ([[International Commission against Impunity in Guatemala]]) [[Iván Velásquez Gómez]]. President Morales also criticized the [[Secretary-General of the United Nations]] [[António Guterres]] and ordered him to immediately replace the CICIG commissioner. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/un-anti-graft-investigator-barred-from-re-entering-guatemala/2018/09/04/fea7dbaa-b083-11e8-8b53-50116768e499_story.html?utm_term=.db19ee09695b (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Jon Kyl]] will replace [[John McCain]] as [[United States Senate|Senator]] of [[Arizona Senate|Arizona]]. [https://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/john-mccain-replacement-jon-kyle_us_5b8eb317e4b0162f472777a3 (''Huffington Post'')]
